name: IntuneWin32App
description: A PowerShell module for managing the complete lifecycle of Win32 applications in Microsoft Intune. Features 40+ functions for packaging, publishing, detection rules, requirement rules, assignments, dependencies, and supersedence with support for x64, x86, and ARM64 architectures.
author: Nickolaj Andersen

securityCheck.aiSummary: The codebase largely represents a legitimate Intune Win32 app management tool; however, there are several security-relevant concerns: (1) external binary download and execution (AzCopy) in remote file transfer logic, (2) a hardcoded app-registration identifier, (3) a module manifest syntax bug, and (4) a potential zip extraction vulnerability when unpacking .intunewin archives. Address these issues by enforcing binary integrity checks, removing hardcoded secrets or clearly documenting overrides, fixing manifest syntax, and strengthening archive extraction security.
